description: Run before the tests. Scans the test and locator files changed on this branch (or all: true for the whole project) and fails any locator without a COR id (the // COR cor:… comment an entry carries), any id COR did not issue here, and any positional pick (.first(), .nth(), .eq(), [n]). With the locator's page open it returns the fix: COR's entry to paste, or the id to add for a locator COR already has a record of.

all.description: Check every file in the project instead of the changed ones.

files.description: Files to check, relative to the project root. Default: changed files.

name: cor_check
title: Check every locator in the test files carries a COR id
